d: A small, bipedal deer-like creature riding atop a massive, shaggy equine beast. The rider is pale cream with an emerald green crown, while the mount is covered in thick, snow-white fur with a massive, frosty white mane and tail. The mount has large, curved ice-blue horns and a thick, bushy tail. Each hand of the rider has three small digits. BODY COLOR: snow-white
